meta.source: Provisional rules compiled from the TCU 2026-27 undergraduate catalog and the archived 2025-26 catalog PDF; replace with the team's verified programs.json
meta.note: TCU Core categories are modeled as hour slots. Writing Emphasis and the Responsible Citizenship categories are assumed to overlap with other courses (the catalog allows overlap: 39-63 hours). Cohort split: catalog text is identical for both cohorts; the team's checklists define the differences.

contradictions.title: 120 vs. 124 total hours
contradictions.text: The catalog says 120 total hours, but older Neeley checklists say 124 for earlier admits. The plan uses 120.
contradictions.source: TCU 2026-27 catalog vs archived Neeley degree checklists

contradictions.title: MANA 30350 is missing
contradictions.text: MANA 30250 requires concurrent enrollment in MANA 30350, and post-Summer-2025 checklists list it, but MANA 30350 isn't in the registrar course export.
contradictions.source: MANA 30250 description and Neeley checklist vs courses-report export

contradictions.title: MANA 30250 / 40250 have no sections
contradictions.text: MANA 30250 and MANA 40250 (1.5 hours each) are in the Business Core but have no sections on the posted schedules.

contradictions.title: ACCT 20153 doesn't exist
contradictions.text: Some Neeley materials reference ACCT 20153, which isn't in the course export (the catalog course is ACCT 20353).

opportunities.name: Neeley Fellows
opportunities.text: About 30 first-year students a year join a three-year honors cohort with enhanced core courses. Talk to an advisor before taking core courses in year one.

opportunities.name: Educational Investment Fund (FINA 40183/40193)
opportunities.text: Apply in junior year after or during FINA 30213; manage a real portfolio for two consecutive senior semesters.

opportunities.name: TIP Board
opportunities.text: Transaction & Investment Professionals Board: mentorship and interview prep for investment banking, equity research and private equity.

opportunities.name: Study abroad
opportunities.text: Faculty-led spring break, Maymester, summer, and semester programs.
